newsitem.title: FRANCE: French TPS to broadcast Portugal's SIC channel.
newsitem.headline: French TPS to broadcast Portugal's SIC channel.

text.p: French digital satellite television service Television par Satellite (TPS) said on Friday it reached an accord to broadcast Portugal's SIC, the leading Portuguese private terrestrial television channel.
The accord gives TPS exclusive rights to carry SIC in France. Up to now SIC has not been available outside Portugal, TPS said in a statement. It gave no financial details.
TPS subscribers, except those who have taken only the cinema option, will receive SIC from mid-September, it said. The move is aimed at some 750,000 Portuguese people living in France.
TPS is operated by TF1, France's leading private terrestrial television channel.
